About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

About the role

Location: Israel – Modiin (Training) / Masmia (Work Location)
Duration: 6 months
Start date: December 2026
Compensation: Paid
Eligibility: Recent Graduate or Early Career specialist
Work authorization: Permitted to work in the job's location

Role Description

As an Data Center Technician (Early Talent), you will gain hands-on experience maintaining and supporting IT infrastructure within our data centers, including modern GPU cloud cluster technologies.

You will learn to troubleshoot and resolve hardware issues, perform physical hardware repairs, support infrastructure maintenance, and ensure the smooth operation of critical systems.

This is a 6-month, hands-on technical training program designed for individuals looking to build a long-term career in data center operations and IT infrastructure.

Program Structure & Working Conditions

The program consists of two phases:

- Month 1 - Training: Full-time training in Modiin, Sunday to Thursday, 9:00–17:00.

- Months 2 - 6 - On-site Operations: Shift-based work at our Masmia data center, following a 4-days-on / 4-days-off rotation, including night shifts and weekends.

Important requirements:

- A valid driver’s license and access to your own car are required, as public transportation to the Masmia site is unavailable during night shifts.

- The role involves physical work, including prolonged standing, working with hardware equipment, and using ladders.

- You must be comfortable working rotating shifts, including nights and weekends.

- You must be able to read and understand technical documentation in English.

Successful participants may be considered for a full-time L1 IT Technician position upon completing the program, subject to performance and available headcount.

Skills You Will Learn

- Diagnosing and resolving IT hardware issues while ensuring continuous support of the data center’s IT infrastructure.

- Collaborating effectively with internal teams and external contractors to address technical and operational challenges.

- Installing, upgrading, replacing, and dismantling hardware based on operational requirements.

- Managing and maintaining fiber optic cables, patch cords, and network connectivity.

- Planning, executing, and monitoring routine IT maintenance tasks to support infrastructure reliability.

- Processing Return Merchandise Authorizations (RMAs) in accordance with established procedures.

- Creating and maintaining technical documentation for hardware configuration, troubleshooting, and maintenance.

- Working cross-functionally with infrastructure, networking, and other technical teams.

We Expect You to Have

- Education or training in a relevant technical field, such as IT, computer hardware, electronics, networking, or practical engineering, through a technical college, Handesaim program, vocational training, or military technical training.

- A strong interest in pursuing a hands-on technical career in data center operations and IT infrastructure.

- Foundational knowledge of computer hardware, networking, and IT systems.

- The ability to read and understand technical documentation in English.

- A valid driver’s license and access to a personal vehicle for commuting to the Masmiya site.

- Willingness and availability to work rotating shifts, including nights and weekends.

- The ability to perform physical tasks associated with data center operations, including prolonged standing and working on ladders, with appropriate safety measures.

- The ability to comply with all safety, security, and confidentiality policies.

- Availability to commit to the full 6-month program.

- Be at least 18 years old by the program start date.

- Legal authorization to work in Israel without requiring sponsorship.

Nice to Have:

- Basic knowledge of Linux operating systems.

- Previous hands-on experience with computer hardware, server maintenance, or IT troubleshooting.

- Familiarity with networking fundamentals and fiber optic connections.

Career Development & Progression

Our Early Talent Program is designed to help you develop the practical skills and experience needed to become an L1 IT Technician.

Throughout the program, you will receive structured training, hands-on experience, and guidance from experienced infrastructure professionals.

Your progress will be assessed through:

- 3-month evaluation: A review of your technical development, performance, and progress against program expectations.

- 6-month evaluation: A final assessment of your readiness for a potential full-time L1 IT Technician position.

Conversion to a permanent L1 IT Technician role is not guaranteed and will depend on individual performance, successful completion of the program, and available headcount.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Structured technical training and mentorship from experienced infrastructure professionals.

- Hands-on experience with modern GPU cloud infrastructure and real-world systems.

- Opportunities to develop practical troubleshooting, hardware maintenance, and data center operations skills.

- A dynamic and collaborative work environment that values initiative and innovation.

- Opportunity to be considered for a full-time L1 IT Technician position following successful completion of the program, subject to performance and business needs.

We’re growing and expanding our products every day. If you’re excited about technology, enjoy hands-on problem-solving, and want to build your career in IT infrastructure, we’d love to hear from you!

Benefits & Perks:

- Competitive compensation

- Career growth and learning opportunities

- Flexibility and ownership

- Collaborative and innovative culture

- Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

- International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

NVIDIA is looking for a HW Mechanical Engineer to join the IC Product Engineering HW team. You will lead the mechanical design and execution of test hardware for NVIDIA’s networking and CPO (Co-Packaged Optics) products: test boards, sockets, handler interfaces, system-level test (SLT) mechanical interfaces, and HTOL platforms.

NVIDIA’s Networking division is a leading supplier of end-to-end InfiniBand and Ethernet connectivity solutions for data centers, including adapter cards, switches, cables and software. Our products deliver industry-leading bandwidth, performance and scalability. The IC PE HW team ensures these products are tested and qualified for high-volume production.

What you’ll be doing:

- Design, define and qualify test sockets, contactors, handler change kits and thermal solutions for high-power, high-speed devices, with full ownership of the mechanical specification, mechanical component selection, and mechanical constraints for board layout (keep-out zones, placement, stiffening). Manage the external vendors who supply them, including drawing reviews and design sign-off.

- Lead lab bring-up and debug, and define the thermal and mechanical constraints of test platforms so they deploy efficiently and robustly on the production floor, while meeting high-speed signal integrity requirements.

- Work with the most advanced ATE platforms in the industry, including Teradyne UltraFLEX / UltraFLEXplus and Advantest V93K testers and probers.

- Develop mechanical interfaces for optical systems on production ATE equipment, and define new design concepts for future CPO products.

- Collaborate with R&D and Production teams: board design, system-level test, signal integrity, layout, firmware and test engineering.

- Lead HTOL (High-Temperature Operating Life) hardware platforms for reliability testing.

What we need to see:

- B.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering.

- 5+ years of experience as a Mechanical Design Engineer, with hands-on 3D CAD (Creo preferred)

- Proven ownership of projects end-to-end, with the ability to work independently and drive multiple projects and vendors in parallel.

- Understanding of digital circuits, power delivery and high-speed design constraints as they affect mechanical design.

- Strong personal skills: self-learner, multi-disciplinary, able to multitask, with excellent interpersonal skills.

Ways to stand out:

- working alongside a board design team.

- System-level understanding and familiarity with production environments (SLT and final test).

- Hands-on experience with test sockets (pogo pin, coax), ATE handlers, and thermal control (tri-temp).

- Experience with high-power, large-body BGA packages, and with thermal analysis or simulation.

- Experience with optical or fiber interfaces in a test setup.

- Experience managing external mechanical vendors and tooling suppliers, including reviewing and approving manufacturing drawings.

- Strong GD&T and tolerance stack-up skills.

- Experience with HTOL, burn-in or other reliability test hardware.

- Ability to mentor junior engineers.

Who We Are

Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology.

What We Offer

Location:
Rehovot,ISR

You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more.

At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits.

About the Role

Applied Materials’ Computing Delivery Engineering group is responsible for end-to-end computing infrastructure for semiconductor manufacturing tools. Each tool is accompanied by a dedicated mini data center — ranging from 3 to 30 hosts — that must be provisioned and configured from bare metal to fully operational state. These systems, which include compute hosts, network elements, storage, and firewalls, operate in air-gapped environments at integrator and customer sites with no dependency on cloud services.

We are seeking an experienced and highly capable DevOps Engineer to maintain all CI/CD processes, tooling, and infrastructure that support a cross-functional development organization. This is a fully hands-on individual contributor role with no managerial responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Hands-On Engineering

- Research, design, implement, and continuously improve end-to-end CI/CD pipelines that support Windows (PowerShell) and Linux (Ansible) based development workflows.

- Architect and maintain automated provisioning pipelines from bare-metal host initialization through full system configuration and readiness validation.

- Design DevOps processes and tooling for air-gapped deployment scenarios, ensuring the full system stack can be delivered and operated independently at integrator and customer sites without cloud connectivity.

- Drive infrastructure-as-code practices across all compute, network, storage, and firewall elements within the tool’s embedded data center.

- Define and enforce pipeline standards, testing gates, code quality checks, and release management processes across the engineering organization.

- Collaborate closely with development and system qualification engineers to understand requirements and translate them into scalable DevOps solutions.

- Develop CI/CD tools for the R&D teams.

- Participate in the specification and planning stages of the system and system development, including monitoring and control mechanisms.

- Troubleshoot and resolve technical infrastructure issues.

Qualifications

Required

- Academic degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.

- 8–10 years of progressive DevOps or infrastructure engineering experience, with deep expertise across the full DevOps toolchain.

- Experience with programming and scripting languages such as C#, Python, Ansible, and PowerShell.

- Expert-level proficiency with CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) and pipeline design.

- Strong hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management tools, including Ansible and PowerShell DSC/scripting.

- Solid understanding of bare-metal provisioning, OS imaging, and host lifecycle management (PXE boot, Kickstart, WinPE, or equivalent).

- Expertise in version control systems (Git) and branching strategies; familiarity with artifact management platforms (e.g., Nexus, JFrog Artifactory).

- Experience with network infrastructure management concepts including VLANs, firewall rule management, and storage integration within CI/CD workflows.

- Fluent English — written and verbal — required for effective cross-cultural collaboration and technical communication with distributed teams.

Preferred

- Background in semiconductor equipment, industrial automation, or embedded systems environments.

- Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Podman) in constrained or air-gapped settings.

- Familiarity with monitoring, observability, and logging stacks (e.g., ELK, Prometheus/Grafana) in on-premise deployments.

- Exposure to security hardening, STIG compliance, or zero-trust network principles in isolated environments.

- Experience working in a hardware–software co-development environment where software delivery is tightly coupled to physical system integration.

Role Profile

The ideal candidate brings the following capabilities to the role:

- Functional Knowledge: Has developed proficiency in a range of analytical processes or procedures to carry out assigned tasks.

- Business Expertise: Has a good understanding of how the team integrates with others to achieve objectives.

- Leadership: May provide informal guidance and support to more junior team members.

- Problem Solving: Provides solutions to problems in situations that are atypical or infrequently occurring based on existing precedents or procedures.

- Impact: Impacts the quality of own work and its contribution to the team.

- Interpersonal Skills: Uses communication skills to regularly exchange information.

Our innovations make possible the technology shaping the future.

Inspeccionar las habitaciones de los huéspedes, las áreas públicas, la piscina, etc. luego de que sean limpiadas por la mucama a fin de asegurar los estándares de calidad.

Encargarse de preparar los informes de disponibilidad de habitaciones, verificar el estado de estas, determinar la discrepancia en la disponibilidad de habitaciones, dar prioridad a la limpieza de las habitaciones, y actualizar el estado de estas de los huéspedes salientes.

Asistir al Departamento de Limpieza en el manejo de las actividades diarias.

Actuar como enlace en la coordinación de esfuerzos del Departamento de Limpieza, Ingeniería, Oficina de Recepción y Lavandería. Documentar y resolver con el Mostrador de Recepción las cuestiones sobre la discrepancia en las habitaciones.

Preparar, distribuir y comunicar los cambios realizados en las hojas de asignación o en las pizarras de trabajo.

Comunicar todas las cuestiones al siguiente turno.

Completar el papeleo requerido.

Asistir a la gerencia en la contratación, capacitación, programación, evaluación, asesoramiento, disciplina, motivación y entrenamiento de los empleados.

Cumplir con todas las políticas y procedimientos de seguridad de la compañía; informar cualquier problema de mantenimiento, peligros para la seguridad, accidentes o lesiones; completar la capacitación y certificaciones sobre seguridad.

Asegurarse de que tanto el uniforme como la apariencia personal sean pulcros y profesionales.

Mantener la privacidad de la información propiedad de la compañía; proteger sus bienes.

Apoyar a todos los compañeros de trabajo y tratarlos con dignidad y respeto.

Dar apoyo al equipo para alcanzar metas comunes.

Cumplir las expectativas y los estándares de aseguramiento de la calidad.

Moverse a una velocidad que se requiera para responder a situaciones de trabajo (por ejemplo, correr, caminar, correr lentamente). Leer y verificar visualmente información en varios formatos (por ejemplo, las letras menudas). Inspeccionar visualmente herramientas, equipos o máquinas (por ejemplo, para identificar defectos). Ingresar y localizar información relacionada con el trabajo usando computadoras o sistemas de punto de ventas.

Agarrar, dar vuelta y manipular objetos de varios tamaños y pesos, lo que requiere habilidades motrices finas y buena coordinación entre las manos y los ojos.

Alcanzar por encima de la cabeza y debajo de la rodillas, incluso agacharse, girar la cintura, arrastrar e inclinarse.

Moverse por espacios angostos, confinados o elevados.

Moverse por superficies inclinadas, desniveladas o resbalosas y escalinatas.

Subir y bajar escalinatas y/o rampas de servicio.

Hacer uso continuo de destreza manual y habilidades motoras empleando con frecuencia ambas manos y funciones motrices finas.

Mover, levantar, transportar y colocar objetos que pesan 55 libras (24,75 Kg) o menos sin asistencia y más de 55 libras (24,75 Kg) con asistencia.

Capacidad de empujar y arrastrar un carro de mantenimiento cargado y otras máquinas relacionadas con el trabajo en superficies inclinadas y desniveladas.

Estar de pie, sentarse, arrodillarse o caminar durante períodos prolongados o con mucha frecuencia durante el turno de trabajo completo.

Escuchar y responder apropiadamente a los problemas de otros empleados.

Hablar con otras personas usando un lenguaje claro y profesional.

Efectuar otras tareas de trabajo razonables solicitadas por sus supervisores.

* Embedded systems basics

* Networking 101

- B.Sc. in Computer Science/Computer Engineering/Electrical Engineering or related field. Make sure to include a grade sheet with your CV in a single PDF

- Knowledge of C programming language

- Experience in embedded SW Development

- Experience with HW/SW interfaces at both the board and chip level

- Understanding of computer architecture

- Personal characteristics: team player, highly motivated, willing to work in a dynamic and demanding environment, creative, and a fast learner

description:
Summary
Apple's wireless chip powers connectivity across every new iPhone — and its successor is already taking shape. Would you like to join Apple's growing wireless silicon development team?
Our Wireless SOC organization owns every aspect of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. It is driven by a world-class, vertically integrated team spanning RF/Analog, Systems/PHY/MAC, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering.
As a Wireless SOC Design Verification Engineer, you'll be at the heart of the chip design effort — owning a meaningful verification scope and growing it project to project.
You'll work alongside DV methodologists, designers, architects, communication systems engineers, and firmware engineers to build reusable testbenches and verification environments using the latest metric-driven verification methodology.

Description
You'll be responsible for pre-silicon RTL verification at the block, subsystem, and top-level SOC, taking your scope from test planning through coverage closure and signoff.
Your activity may focus at block level, subsystem level, or top-level SOC, including end-to-end simulations of the entire data/control path.

Minimum qualifications
BS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Engineering
Solid problem-solving and debugging skills with constrained-random verification
Understanding of digital logic design, SOC architecture, and microarchitecture
Self-motivated and dedicated, with proven creative thinking capabilities
Ability to handle multiple tasks and priorities work to meet deadlines

Preferred qualifications
Hands-on experience across the verification cycle: test planning, testbench implementation, test creation and debug, and coverage closure
Strong SystemVerilog and Verilog skills, with solid working knowledge of UVM and DV methodologies
Great teammate with excellent communication skills and the desire to take on diverse challenges
Experience taking at least one ASIC/SOC from concept through tape-out
Experience with MAC or PHY verification
Experience verifying IP or top-level integration for a WiFi or Bluetooth SOC, or knowledge of wireless protocols
Verification experience with PCIe, bus fabric/NOC, or AHB/AXI-based architectures in a UVM environment
Experience with low-power verification, UPF, boot-up, power-cycling, and HW/FW interaction
Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and/or formal tools (e.g., JasperGold)
Experience defining coverage space and writing coverage models
Experience with embedded CPU verification; programming in C/C++ or assembly
Scripting in Python or Perl; interest in applying AI/ML to verification workflows
title: Junior Wireless SoC Design Verification Engineer
